routes.name: Palau Entry Form
routes.summary: All passengers must submit the Palau Entry Form online at most 72 hours before departure. You get a QR code to show at check-in and on arrival. One form can cover a family.
steps: Submit the form at palautravel.pw within 72 hours before departure
Save the confirmation email and QR code
Show it at check-in and on arrival

routes.name: Visa on arrival
routes.summary: Palau is generally described as visa on arrival, but I could not confirm stay length, fees or eligible nationalities on an official page. Call the Bureau of Immigration at 680-488-2498 or 2678.

other: Official immigration page was unreachable. Stay length and fees not confirmed.

routes.name: Foreign Investment Approval Certificate
routes.summary: Foreign businesses in Palau apply to the Foreign Investment Board for a certificate. The page lists forms but no thresholds or residency link.

other: Contact fib@palaugov.org. Investment minimums and visa links not confirmed.
